item.title: Anji Licheng Tangquan — Private Hot-Spring Villas from ¥499 (≈$69)
item.description:
Deal price: deluxe room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + afternoon tea for two + fishing — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥1,399) · Valid Nov 12, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Saturday +¥100 · Refundable if unbooked

Tucked into the bamboo hills of Anji, Licheng Tangquan is a Japanese-style hot-spring resort built around private soaking: several packages put a private hot-spring pool on your own terrace, fillable whenever you like. Even the entry-level room comes with breakfast for two, afternoon tea for two, fishing, an open-air cinema, billiards, an infinity pool, a viewing terrace for photos, a kids’ play area and a gym — and the two-night stay and the villa tiers add tea around the stove (围炉煮茶) and a photo shoot.

item.title: Beijing Wukuang Junlan — Winter Family Stay with Super Wings Playland from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description:
Deal price: Xishan room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child + Super Wings playland ticket — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,688) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · New Year & Spring Festival zero top-up on the dinner tier · Refundable if unbooked

A well-known Beijing family hotel at the foot of the Western Hills, Wukuang Junlan is built for winter weekends with kids: the Super Wings playland (one child + one accompanying parent per ticket), the free Lanjingling kids’ activity programme (book ahead — slots fill up), the free kids’ play centre, an indoor pool with a warm shallow pool for little ones, a gym and free parking. The headline tier pairs all of that with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child; the other two tiers swap the playland for the Cloud Exploration Park + Nanwang’s noodles set meal, or for a weekend buffet dinner for 2 adults + 1 child — the dinner tier carries zero top-up over New Year and Spring Festival.

item.title: Shenzhen Greater China Sheraton Buffet — Lunch for 1 Adult + 1 Child from ¥138 (≈$19)
item.description:
Deal price: lunch for 1 adult + 1 child under 1.2 m — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥298) · Valid Oct 15, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Weekends & New Year no top-up · Blacked out Dec 24, 25, 31 · Refundable if unbooked

The Sheraton’s Yiju Xuan buffet in Futian is running a Taiwan night-market theme for dinner (until around Dec 15): oyster omelettes, salt-and-pepper chicken, braised beef offal with instant noodles, takoyaki, tempura, Taiwanese braised pork rice and curry fish balls — plus a weekend-only grouper hotpot (龙趸石斑鱼, Friday to Sunday dinner), roast meats, a teppanyaki station with garlic oysters and black-pepper steaks, sushi and sashimi, and free-flowing red and white wine. Lunch keeps the same spread at a lower price, and weekends and the New Year holiday carry no top-up.

item.title: Xiamen Jimei Guole Park — 2 Adults + 2 Kids, 14 Activities from ¥179 (≈$25)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 adults + 2 kids under 1.1 m, 14 activities in one ticket — ¥179 (≈$25, was ¥668) · Valid Nov 27 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use immediately · Refundable if unused, auto-refund after expiry

A 40,000㎡ family park in Jimei that packs a whole day into one ticket: gate entry, 11 rides (seal planes, pirate ship, bumper cars, carousel, mini shuttle, shark battle, ball-spray cars, flying chairs, Thomas train, around-the-world and drift racers), 3 animal-feeding experiences (rabbit garden, deer garden and starry pasture — the piglet races are a guest favourite), plus a slide world, a bouncing-cloud zone and Hobbit cabins. Reviewers keep coming back for the animals — alpacas, sika deer and the piglet races — and for the sheer size of the place, with room for kids to run free.

item.title: Xinxing Chanquan Hot Spring Resort — Zen Retreat + Unlimited Hot Springs from ¥999 (≈$139)
item.description:
Deal price: deluxe room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child + unlimited Zen hot springs + dinner for two — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,599) · Valid Nov 12, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Saturday +¥200 · Refundable if unbooked

South China’s first Zen-culture hotel sits right beside Guoen Temple — the home temple of Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of Zen — in the Liuzu Hometown resort area of Xinxing, Yunfu. The whole stay is built around slowing down: unlimited soaks in the Zen hot springs, indoor and outdoor pools, and a choice of six Zen activities (tai chi, Zen music, yoga, seated meditation, sutra copying or Go). The package also includes a set dinner for two (three dishes, a soup and pastries, served on arrival day or the next lunch), a visit to the Zen culture art gallery and its rosewood exhibition hall, plus billiards, a kids’ play area, a film centre, a gym and catch-your-own-fish fun by the stream.

item.title: Hengdian Film City — 3 Days / 2 Nights + 9 Attractions from ¥1,478 (≈$205)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights at a Hengdian resort hotel + 9-attraction tickets for 2 adults + 2 children — ¥1,478 (≈$205, was ¥2,088) · Valid Nov 20 – Nov 30, 2026 only · Book by 17:00 the day before · No weekend top-up

Hengdian is “China’s Hollywood” — the studio town where most of the country’s historical dramas are filmed — and this deal pairs a 2-night stay with 5-day unlimited entry to all 9 attractions for the whole family: Qin Palace, the Qingming Riverside Scene, the Ming & Qing Palace, Guangzhou Street & Hong Kong Street, Dream Valley, the International Circus City, the two Yuanming New Garden parks (Spring and Summer) and Dream Spring Valley. Dress up in costume, wander palace sets, and you may well bump into a film crew at work.

item.title: Jiaxing Kaiyuan Senbo — 1 Night + Hot Spring or Fantasy Island from ¥799 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: deluxe room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + 2 tickets to the Xihe Hot Spring or Fantasy Island — ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,298) · Valid Nov 14, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

Jiaxing’s Kaiyuan Senbo sits beside the South & North Lakes — a 4A scenic area where mountain, sea and lake meet — about an hour’s drive from both Shanghai and Hangzhou. The headline this winter is the return of the Xihe Hot Spring: a 5,300㎡ “natural healing” spa with outdoor pools, sweat rooms and a kids’ play area, built around the idea of soaking in the forest rather than in a concrete bathhouse. If the kids would rather climb than soak, swap the hot spring for Fantasy Island, a 2,300㎡ indoor play zone with 20+ rides and activities for every age. Either way the deal also throws in a craft-workshop experience, a short photo shoot (3 edited photos + a 15-second video) and a mountain-and-water show at 19:00 and 20:00 each evening.

item.title: Shanghai Sun Island Resort Stay — Island Room + Forest Hot Spring from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description:
Deal price: island deluxe room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child + forest hot spring or activity pass — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,599) · Pre-sale: book now, stay Dec 4, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Book by 16:59 on the day · Refundable if unbooked

Sun Island is a whole island to itself — 2,500 mu of trees, lakes and villa-style rooms in Zhujiajiao, about an hour from central Shanghai — and this winter package is built around its forest hot spring: 8 outdoor pools at 40°C+, five themed energy rooms (salt-heat palace, charcoal hall, herbal steam, jade room), and a spa that lends hanfu-style robes, so a soak feels like stepping into a classical Chinese painting. If you’d rather keep moving, swap the hot spring for the Yueyou Pass — a day of nature classes, outdoor challenges, DIY crafts and animal encounters across the island, with a late-night snack included — plus a kids’ exploration park, a mindfulness class for adults and a photo shoot with costume and makeup.

item.title: Shenzhen MGallery Seafood Buffet Dinner for Two from ¥358 (≈$50)
item.description:
Deal price: themed seafood buffet dinner for two — ¥358 (≈$50, was ¥1,099) · Valid through Dec 30, 2026 · Not valid Dec 24–25 · Dinner 17:30–21:00 · Book at least 4 hours ahead

Shenzhen’s MGallery hotel in Longhua puts on a full seafood buffet that reads like a greatest-hits list: an ice pool of baby abalone, giant river prawns, New Zealand green-lipped mussels, sea snails and prawns; sashimi and sushi sliced to order; oysters served raw, garlic-grilled, black-bean-grilled or in an air pot; and a charcoal grill turning out Beef Wellington, lamb and Atlantic cod alongside stir-fried crab three ways and Singapore laksa and giant grouper soup from the noodle station. Desserts run to low-sugar Basque durian cake, canelés on weekends, six ice creams and seasonal fruit, with red and white wine, beer and soft drinks free-flow all evening.

item.title: Zhoushan Kaiyuan Senbo — 1 Night + Water Park from ¥599 (≈$83)
item.description:
Deal price: mountain-view room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + 2 park tickets — ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥1,028) · Valid Nov 23, 2026 – Jan 30, 2027 · No weekend top-up · Book by 23:59 the same day · Refundable if unbooked

Zhoushan’s Kaiyuan Senbo is the seaside branch of the family — a resort on Zhujiajian Island, 15 minutes from the ferry to Putuo Mountain, where you can watch the sunset from the 17th floor and fall asleep to the sound of the waves. The centrepiece is the 7,500㎡ indoor heated water park under a giant glass dome: 30°C year-round, with slides, a wave pool, a lazy river and a water-climbing wall — plus Fantasy Island for younger kids (ocean-ball pits, rainbow slides, climbing nets) and Player One, an arcade hall with AR/VR games, karting and an interactive cinema. The headline 2-night deal is the garden room at ¥998 with a ticket per night; the first 10 rooms booked each day get a free one-tier upgrade.

item.title: Shanghai Sun Island Forest Hot Spring from ¥98 (≈$14): Outdoor Pools, Energy Sweat Rooms, Massage & Tea Break
item.description:
Deal price: 1 ticket ¥98 (≈$14, was ¥188) · Usable Dec 4, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Blackout Jan 1–2 & Feb 5–13, 2027 · Refundable if unused

A hot spring in the forest without leaving Shanghai. The Sun Island Forest Hot Spring sits on a 2,500-mu island in Zhujiajiao — the resort area is a cluster of villas on its own island, about 1.5 hours from central Shanghai — and the deal is an early-bird ticket to its “Forest Aroma Spring · Healing Time” package: 8 outdoor pools at 40°C+, energy sweat rooms, a short massage or craft session, a bottle of custom essential oil to take home and a Chinese tea break. The pools are set among trees and lakeside paths, and the spa lends hanfu-style robes, so the whole visit feels like a walk through a classical Chinese painting.

item.title: Tianjin Polar Ocean Hotel from ¥699 (≈$97): Polar Room for 2 Adults + 1 Child with Unlimited Polar Park Entry
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥2,235) · Valid Nov 25, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · Blackout Feb 5, 2027 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

Sleep next to the penguins. The Tianjin Polar Ocean Hotel sits right beside the Polar Ocean Park in Binhai New Area — the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region’s ocean-themed family hotel — and the deal is a polar-themed room for 2 adults + 1 child with breakfast and park tickets that allow unlimited re-entry over 2 days. The park itself has 11 zones — Antarctic penguin island, a mysterious Arctic village, an undersea tunnel, a shark harbour, a coral sea, a beluga bay and a jellyfish hall — with penguins, polar bears, sea lions, walruses and seals. The hotel adds a kids’ castle play fort, a “Barty magic” science class, a bedtime story session and its own VIP entrance into the park, so you skip the main queue.

item.title: Wen'an Hilton 3 Nights from ¥1,299 (≈$180): Family Stay by the Huamei Shengdi Ski Resort — No Surcharge on Weekends, New Year or Spring Festival
item.description:
Deal price: 3 nights from ¥1,299 (≈$180, was ¥1,899) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Apr 29, 2027 · No surcharge on weekends, New Year or Spring Festival · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

A Hilton base camp for a ski weekend — without the ski-resort price. The Wen’an Hilton is the second Hilton in Hebei, set in the Lüneng Eco Zone about 1.5 hours from Beijing: a European-castle-style hotel with 227 rooms from 47㎡, lake views all around and the Huamei Shengdi ski resort (opened November 14, 2026) a short drive away. The deal is 3 nights for ¥1,299 — or 3 rooms for 1 night, if the whole family comes at once — with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child each night, a tractor park, a kids’ playground, an indoor heated pool, a gym and a weekend shuttle train around the resort.

item.title: Xiamen Kempinski Lunch Buffet from ¥156 (≈$22): 2nd-Floor Café by Yundang Lake — 2 Adults Bring 1 Child Under 6 Free
item.description:
Deal price: lunch from ¥156 per person (≈$22, was ¥278) · Valid Nov 25, 2026 – Feb 13, 2027 · Wednesday–Sunday only · Blackout Dec 24, 2026 & Feb 5, 2027 · Book by 20:00 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

A five-star buffet at a neighbourhood price. The Kempinski Hotel is the 198-metre sail-shaped tower on Yundang Lake in central Xiamen, and its 2nd-floor café has been serving its buffet for 12 years — the menu is refreshed every season and the regulars keep coming back. Expect 100+ dishes: a fresh seafood counter, European, Japanese and Southeast Asian stations and Chinese classics, all cooked to order at open kitchens. Dinner adds salmon, grilled oysters, teppanyaki foie gras and Peking duck, served course by course.

item.title: Zhangzhou Duoleng Hot Spring Ticket from ¥59.9 (≈$8): 1 Adult + 1 Child, Weekends & Holidays with No Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child ¥59.9 (≈$8) · Valid Nov 19, 2026 – Jun 30, 2027 · Weekends & public holidays: no surcharge · Buy and use the same day · Refundable if unused

Forty-five minutes from Xiamen, with no weekend top-up. Duoleng Hot Spring in Jiaomei is a 20,000㎡ seawater hot-spring garden where every pool is carved from a single block of granite — dozens of tonnes of yellow granite, hollowed out one by one. The deal is a day ticket for 1 adult + 1 child under 1.2 m for ¥59.9, usable any day of the week including weekends and public holidays, with no surcharge at all. (The same venue also sells a hotel stay with unlimited springs — see our Duoleng Hot Spring Hotel page — this ticket is the day-visit version.)

item.title: Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring Mansion from ¥799 (≈$111): 50㎡ Room with Private Soak Pool + Breakfast & Unlimited Hot Springs for 2 Adults + 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,398) · Valid Jun 23 – Dec 30, 2026 (1-night packages) · Nov 24 – Dec 30, 2026 (2-night packages) · Any day of the week · Statutory holidays and the eve of a holiday are blacked out · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

Banyue Mountain sits in a forested valley in Changtai, about an hour from Xiamen, built around strontium-rich soda springs and a hot-spring park with 50+ pools you can soak in as often as you like during your stay. The draw of this deal is the room itself: a 50㎡ mansion room with its own private hot-spring soak pool, so you can bathe without leaving your room, plus breakfast and park entry for 2 adults + 2 kids (one child under 1.4 m, one under 1.2 m).

item.title: Gubei Water Town Inn Stay from ¥399 (≈$55): 1 Night + Scenic Tickets + Hot-Spring Baths + Great Wall or Afternoon Tea
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥510) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Jul 15, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

Sleep inside the water town itself. This all-in-one deal puts you in a Gubei Water Town inn for one night — one of 11 inns, assigned randomly, so you book the town, not a specific inn or room — with scenic-area tickets for two, hot-spring bath tickets for two, and a pick of one extra: Simatai Great Wall daytime tickets for two, a DIY lamp, or afternoon tea for two. The town is at its best after dark, when the canals light up and the drone show runs over the rooftops, and the kids’ play hall, pools and hot springs fill the daytime.

item.title: Huizhou Fuli Yangshenggu Hot Spring Villa from ¥489 (≈$68): 4-Bedroom Villa with Private Soak Pool, KTV, BBQ & Mahjong — No Surcharge Sun–Fri
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥489 (≈$68, was ¥1,288) · Valid Nov 18, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Sunday–Friday: no surcharge · Book by 16:00 on the day · Refundable if unbooked

This is a whole villa for the price of a hotel room. At Fuli Yangshenggu in Longmen’s Nankun Mountain area — about two hours from Guangzhou or Shenzhen — the deal is a 4-bedroom villa with its own private hot-spring soak pool, plus free KTV, an electric barbecue grill, a kitchen with utensils and an automatic mahjong table. It sleeps a big family or a group of friends, and the villa is yours alone: room types are assigned randomly within the villa category, so you book the size, not a specific unit.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco Warm Winter Stay from ¥1,588 (≈$221): 2 Nights + Breakfast for 2 Adults & 2 Kids, Minibar & Romantic Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights from ¥1,588 (≈$221, was ¥2,188) · Valid Nov 21, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 22:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked, auto-refund on expiry

Winter in Sanya is the point: while the north freezes, Sanya Bay stays warm enough for the beach. The voco Sanya Bay — an IHG hotel on the Coconut Dream Corridor — puts you in a balcony room with breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids every morning, a stocked minibar on your first day, and a bundle of extras: a romantic dinner for two, a photo shoot (5 digital photos included), a shuttle to the Xidao marine culture area and another to the cdf Sanya International Duty Free City.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Snow World Ski + Hot Spring for Two from ¥799 (≈$111): 4 Hours on All Slopes + Hot Spring Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,196) · Valid Nov 21 – Dec 31, 2026 · Weekday ¥799 / Weekend ¥899 · Book by 23:57 the day before · Refundable if unused

Ski in the morning, soak in the afternoon. Yaoxue Snow World in Lingang is a 98,000㎡ indoor snow park held at −3°C to −5°C all year, with five slopes — a green run (81 m), a beginner run (75 m), a blue run (460 m), a red run (314 m) and a black run (340 m), 1,270 m of slopes in total. This duo deal pairs a 4-hour intermediate/advanced ski pass for two with hot-spring tickets for two at the Crowne Plaza hotel next door, so you warm up properly after the cold.

item.title: Longyan Guanzhai Migu Baixiang Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Hakka Mountain Rooms, Two Meals & 400 Mu of Forest at the 5A Guanzhaishan Gate
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥999) · Valid Nov 19, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

This is the hotel to pick if your kids would rather be outside than in a lobby. The resort sits at the foot of Guanzhaishan, a 5A national scenic area — the hotel’s back gate is effectively the mountain’s entrance, about a 4-minute drive to the main trails — and it owns 400 mu of private forest filled with more than 400 species of rare plants and animals, from red-bellied squirrels to kingfishers. The three low buildings are built in the local Hakka roundhouse style, with grey tiles and rammed-earth walls, and the lobby runs a 30-metre wooden front desk under a glass roof. In winter the forest here runs 3–6°C cooler than the city, and the air smells of pine and woodsmoke.

item.title: Ningde Baixiang Sanduao Hotel from ¥799 (≈$111): Lakeside Rooms, Two Meals & She Ethnic Dress-Up for the Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,499) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 31, 2026 · Any day of the week · Book by 23:59 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

Ningde is one of Fujian’s quieter coastal cities — a deep-water harbour town the poet Guo Moruo once described as a lake in the sky — and this is its big lakeside hotel. The Baixiang Sanduao sits on the East Lake waterfront in the Dongqiao district, backed by Damen Mountain, with 295 rooms spread along the lakefront promenade. The 12-metre lobby is hung with a relief of Huotong, the historic town nearby, and the whole building leans into a grand new-Chinese style: lake greens, coastal blues, and a lot of glass facing the water.

item.title: Shenzhen Luwan International Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): French Chateau Rooms by the Sea, 3D Cinema & a Sea-View Splash Pool
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥1,288) · Valid Sep 24 – Dec 31, 2026 · Any day of the week, no weekend surcharge · Book by 17:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

Shenzhen’s east coast is the city’s answer to a seaside weekend — and this is the most theatrical place to stay on it. The Luwan International is a French-chateau resort set between the hills and the sea in the Meisha Bay resort area: three sides mountains, one side ocean, about 800 metres from the water. With Metro Line 8’s phase 3 now open, you can genuinely take the metro to the beach — the hotel is a 10-minute walk from Xiyong station’s Exit C — and the coastal boardwalk, the sea-view road and the beaches are all within a short drive.

item.title: Wen'an Hilton Curio Collection Hotel from ¥358 (≈$50): Lakeside Rooms, Afternoon Tea & New Year Fireworks by Huamei Shengdi
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥358 (≈$50, was ¥699) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Apr 29, 2027 · Any day of the week · Weekends, New Year & Spring Festival: no surcharge · Book by 23:00 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

If Beijing’s winter weekends feel too familiar, this is the escape 1.5 hours south: the Huamei Shengdi resort area in Wen’an, a spread of 10,000 mu of forest and 1,000 mu of lakes with a ski resort (opened November 14, 2026), a tractor park, go-karts and a New Year fireworks season. The hotel at its heart is a Hilton Curio Collection property built around wine culture — a European-castle exterior, a lobby that greets you with red-wine cocktails, and 266 rooms in a clean modern style, some with lake views.

item.title: Xishuangbanna 5-Day Rainforest Family Tour from ¥3,380 (≈$469) a Child: Private Rainforest, Elephant Feeding & a Dai Princess Role-Play
item.description:
Deal price: 5 days / 4 nights from ¥3,380 per child (≈$469, was ¥4,380, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥3,980 (≈$553) · Ages: children welcome, pregnant travellers cannot join · Departures Jan 16 – Feb 20, 2027 · Book at least 2 days ahead, then confirm with customer service before buying your flights

Winter in Xishuangbanna is the opposite of winter almost everywhere else in China: warm, green, and smelling of rain. This 5-day tour is built around a 2,930-mu private rainforest on Jino Mountain — a patch of forest the operator spent two years scouting — where indigenous Jino guides lead the hike, teaching kids to recognise strangler figs, buttress roots, century-old dragon-scale trees and the ancient fern Alsophila. The pace is deliberately unhurried: no herding, no crowds, and the group caps at 25 people.

item.title: Guangzhou Jinyezi Hot Spring Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): Mountain Hot Springs, Water Park & Two Meals for 2 Adults + 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥988) · Valid Nov 18, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 17:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

They say summer is for water play and winter is for hot springs — but autumn is Jinyezi’s best season. Tucked into the forested hills beside the 4A Baishuizhai scenic area, about 26°C year-round and wrapped in 400,000 mu of forest at the foot of the Nankun Mountains, this Country Garden–run resort does the whole family day in one place: swim in the morning, soak in the evening.

item.title: Guangzhou Wanfu Hilton Crab Buffet from ¥168 (≈$23): 100+ Dishes, Hairy Crab & a Kids' Cooking Class
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child lunch from ¥168 (≈$23, was ¥299) · Lunch valid Sep 25 – Dec 27, 2026, weekends only · Dinner packages valid to Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 12:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

The Wanfu Hilton — a Hilton in the Wanda business district in Baiyun, right by the Guangzhou Children’s Activity Center — has put a crab theme on its buffet for the autumn: “Golden Autumn with Crabs”. The headline is the per-person crab dish: on weekdays you get drunken hairy crab or steamed hairy crab with ginger vinegar; on Friday to Sunday you get both. Around it, the buffet runs to 100+ dishes, and the hotel’s own rating on the booking platform is 4.8.

item.title: Hainan Wanning 5-Day Family Tour from ¥3,980 (≈$553) a Child: Rainforest, Surfing & Beach Hotels — No Early Mornings
item.description:
Deal price: 5 days / 4 nights from ¥3,980 per child (≈$553, was ¥4,780, early-bird ¥800 off) · Adults from ¥4,980 (≈$692) · Ages 5–15 · Departures Dec 25, 2026 – Feb 26, 2027 · Book at least 2 days ahead, then confirm with customer service before buying your flights

This one is built for families who want a tropical break without the drill-sergeant schedule: no early mornings, no rushing, no changing hotels every night. The group meets in Haikou and ends in Sanya, spending the middle of the trip in Wanning — the stretch of coast that travel magazines keep calling China’s answer to Southern California, Bali and the Maldives in one place — and the pace is deliberately slow, with a professional tour leader looking after the kids the whole way.

item.title: Haining Chang'an Kaiyuan Mingdu Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): Opening Deal — 2 Nights + Meals, No Weekend or Holiday Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥699) · Valid Nov 24, 2026 – May 30, 2027 · No surcharge on weekends, New Year, Spring Festival or May Day · Book by 19:00 the day before use · Refundable if unbooked

This is an opening deal for a brand-new hotel: the Chang’an Kaiyuan Mingdu holds its opening ceremony on November 25, 2026, and the packages are priced for the launch — the 2-night headline rate of ¥588 works out to ¥294 a night with a meal thrown in per night, and the long validity runs all the way through May Day 2027 with zero surcharge on weekends, New Year, Spring Festival or May Day.

item.title: Xiamen Eye Ferris Wheel from ¥39.9 (≈$6): Air-Conditioned Cabins with 360° Views of Gulangyu
item.description:
Deal price: child ticket (1–1.4 m) from ¥39.9 (≈$6, was ¥78) · Valid Nov 9 – Nov 30, 2026 · Buy-and-use, no reservation needed · Refundable anytime, auto-refund after expiry

The Xiamen Eye is the new landmark wheel at Haishang World in Huli — 62 metres up, with 32 spherical glass cabins that each hold 6 people, air conditioning and free WiFi inside, and a full 360° panoramic window. One slow revolution takes about 13 minutes, and the view changes completely with the light: Gulangyu in the daytime, the sunset over the bay, and the harbour lights after dark. Go in the evening if you can — that’s when the cabins light up and the night view is at its best.
